title: A foldable camera drone, shell to boards to studies
pickerTitle: Camera drone: body, boards and studies
line: A foldable photography drone: lofted two-part shell, folding arms, a 3-axis gimbal, a flight controller and a 4-in-1 ESC, with circuit, thermal and modal studies.
description: A generic foldable camera drone in one project. The body is a smooth lofted shell split into upper and lower halves, with vents, a status window and a flush rear battery; four arms fold on hinge pivots with cowled motor pods and folding props; a 3-axis gimbal hangs under the nose. The flight controller and the 4-in-1 ESC are schematics with routed four-layer boards on bosses inside the shell. The flight controller simulates its 5 V buck start-up and setpoint tolerance, the ESC its gate-drive switching; the arm has modal and hinge-load studies, and the ESC a thermal study inside the shell.
